{{Quote|To all Republic citizens in the Red Light Sector: Be advised the Gauntlet criminal gang has set up a death duel tournament in the back alleys. Poor refugees are running the gang's ordeal for credit rewards. The Gauntlet is broadcasting holos of these fights. No refugee has survived to collect a prize. The Hutt Cartel refuses to intervene in this despicable "entertainment." All tourists should avoid the area, but trained Republic agents are encouraged to end the Gauntlet's activities by destroying its holorecording equipment and driving off the gangsters.|Republic Embassy Security Service issues a Citizen Travel Advisory on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="RESS" />}}
The '''Republic Embassy Security Service''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement force]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It worked with the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]] and provided protection for embassies on various [[Planet/Legends|planets]] outside the Republic. It also issued travel warnings about locations or persons that could pose a threat to the safety of traveling Republic citizens such as on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="RESS" />
